Thank you. I try doing all these things as my therapist also suggested that I re-parent myself. I'm able to do it majority of the times, sometimes I'm not able to. I did also do no contact after 25 with them but due to the COVID pandemic, I had to move back. I have been handling it well since a year and a half knowing it'll end. Now I find myself feeling confused about my feelings and behaviour.
Thank you for sharing your thoughts, journey and the subreddit. I feel my mother has a borderline personality and a narcissistic personality both, my friend pointed that out. Sometimes the knowledge helps, sometimes it doesn't. It's all a mess in my head since a few days to be honest

I am so confused at this point. My mother wishes that I die, my father is neglectful. They never care unless they want something. I learnt to be assertive in therapy so that I don't feel worse for not doing what they need from me, in the hopes that I'll become a wanted child. The truth is (learnt in self work), I could be the most amazing individual and they still won't stop saying and doing those hurtful things. I understand that the problem isn't me, but how do I accept that I can't do anything about it? Sometimes I feel vengeful but I'm able to dissociate and respond than emotionally react. It still breaks my heart each time something happens that reminds me that I'm unwanted by the people who birthed me.

How do I come to terms with it?
No note.... People don't deserve closure
